```{r}
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)

  mutate(

    color_high = relevel(factor(color_high), ref = "Y"),
    feet_high = relevel(factor(feet_high), ref = "C")
  )
```

```{r}
library(ordinal)
df_long3 <- df_long3 |>
  mutate(abs_feature_importance_ord = ordered(abs_feature_importance))

model_clmm <- clmm(abs_feature_importance_ord ~ task * feature_relevance + (1 | participant), data = df_long3, link = "logit" )

summary(model_clmm)
```



```{r}
library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)

emm_probs <- emmeans(
  model_clmm,
  ~ task * feature_relevance * abs_feature_importance_ord,
  mode = "prob"
)

emm_probs_df <- as.data.frame(emm_probs)

names(emm_probs_df)
ggplot(
  emm_probs_df,
  aes(x = task, y = prob, fill = abs_feature_importance_ord)
) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_relevance) +
  labs(
    x = "Task",
    y = "Predicted probability",
    fill = "Importance rating",
    title = "Predicted Ordinal Rating Probabilities"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
model_bayes_ord <- brm(
  abs_feature_importance_ord ~ task * feature_relevance + (1|participant),
  data = df_long,
  family = cumulative("logit"),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = b),          # fixed effects
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = Intercept),  # thresholds
    prior(exponential(1), class = sd)        # random effect SD
  ),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 42
)
```

```{r}
library(tidybayes)

# Extract posterior draws for the contrast
emm_draws <- emmeans(model_bayes_ord, ~ task | feature_relevance) |>
  contrast(method = "pairwise") |>
  gather_emmeans_draws()

# Probability that accommodate > predict for irrelevant features
emm_draws |>
  filter(feature_relevance == "irrelevant",
         contrast == "predict - accommodate") |>
  summarise(prob_accommodate_higher = mean(.value < 0),
            median = median(.value),
            lower_95 = quantile(.value, 0.025),
            upper_95 = quantile(.value, 0.975))
```

```{r}
df_merged <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_merged_foodRatings.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict")
  )
df_merged <- df_merged |>
  mutate(
    color_relevance = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "color", "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    feet_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "feet", "irrelevant", "relevant")
  )

model_trial <- lmer(
  testing_responses ~
    task * color_match_high +
    task * feet_match_high +
    (1 | conditionOrder),
  data = df_merged
)
summary(model_trial)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 14
check_model(model_trial)
```

```{r}
df_merged <- df_merged |>
  mutate(
    color_relevance = relevel(factor(color_relevance), ref = "irrelevant"),
    feet_relevance  = relevel(factor(feet_relevance), ref = "irrelevant")
  )

model_trial_relevance <- lmer(
  testing_responses ~
    task * color_match_high * color_relevance +
    task * feet_match_high * feet_relevance +
    (1 | conditionOrder),
  data = df_merged
)

summary(model_trial_relevance)
```

```{r}
library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)

# Color interaction
pred_color <- ggpredict(
  model_trial,
  terms = c("color_match_high", "task")
)

ggplot(pred_color, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.08) +
  labs(
    x = "Low Fertility State - High Fertility State",
    y = "Predicted fertility rating",
    color = "Task",
    title = "Task × Color"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "No", "1" = "Yes")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
pred_feet <- ggpredict(
  model_trial,
  terms = c("feet_match_high", "task")
)

ggplot(pred_feet, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  labs(
    x = "Low Fertility State - High Fertility State",
    y = "Predicted fertility rating",
    color = "Task",
    title = "Task × Feet"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "No", "1" = "Yes")) +
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
df_cue <- df_merged |>
  select(
    task, conditionOrder, item, testing_responses,
    relevant_dim, irrelevant_dim,
    color_high, feet_high,
    color, feet,
    color_relevance, feet_relevance
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(task, conditionOrder, relevant_dim, irrelevant_dim,
                color_high, feet_high, color_relevance, feet_relevance),
    names_from = item,
    values_from = testing_responses
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    # Feet effect: high feet minus low feet, holding color constant
    feet_effect = case_when(
      feet_high == "F" ~ mean(c(Y_F - Y_C, G_F - G_C), na.rm = TRUE),
      feet_high == "C" ~ mean(c(Y_C - Y_F, G_C - G_F), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),

    # Color effect: high color minus low color, holding feet constant
    color_effect = case_when(
      color_high == "Y" ~ mean(c(Y_F - G_F, Y_C - G_C), na.rm = TRUE),
      color_high == "G" ~ mean(c(G_F - Y_F, G_C - Y_C), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(
    task, conditionOrder, relevant_dim, irrelevant_dim,
    color_relevance, feet_relevance,
    feet_effect, color_effect
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(feet_effect, color_effect),
    names_to = "feature_dimension",
    values_to = "cue_effect"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature_dimension = recode(
      feature_dimension,
      feet_effect = "feet",
      color_effect = "color"
    ),
    feature_relevance = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "feet" ~ feet_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "color" ~ color_relevance
    ),
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "feet"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "irrelevant")
  )
```

```{r}
model_cue <- lmer(
  cue_effect ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension +
    (1 | conditionOrder),
  data = df_cue
)

summary(model_cue)

# Task comparisons within each feature × relevance combination
emm_cue <- emmeans(
  model_cue,
  ~ task | feature_dimension * feature_relevance
)

emm_cue
pairs(emm_cue, adjust = "bonferroni")

# Optional: all cell means
emm_all <- emmeans(
  model_cue,
  ~ task * feature_dimension * feature_relevance
)

emm_all
```
```{r}
ggplot(df_cue, aes(x = task, y = cue_effect, fill = feature_relevance)) +
  geom_violin(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    alpha = 0.45,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = feature_relevance),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.8),
    alpha = 0.35,

  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_dimension) +
  labs(
    x = "Task",
    y = "High - Low Rating",
    fill = "Feature relevance",
    color = "Feature relevance"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```
